lore: Bread that took on a life of its own, and then a filling.
use: Built on a cutting board: one bread plus up to five ingredients, butter first for +10%. Hunger and saturation add up; eating takes 1.6 s plus 0.2 s per ingredient. Equal ones stack to 16.
secret: Effects of equal ingredients merge: strongest level, summed duration. Butter lengthens them, capped at twice the longest.

lore: A knife that cuts only what is meant to be cut.
use: Craft one stick and four iron nuggets. 250 durability, damage 2, speed 2.0, anvil repair with iron nuggets. It opens bread on a cutting board and cuts cheese, butter, melons and cakes.
secret: With butter in the other hand it butters opened bread before the toppings go on.

lore: A block that remembers being milk.
use: Ripens from milk in a cauldron after about 2.5 minutes; harvest it with an empty hand. It holds 16 slices, cut one by one with a knife. Butter never spoils.
secret: A matching slice restores a cut layer. Its friction is 0.9, so it is slippery underfoot.

lore: A thin slice of golden calm.
use: Not edible. Hold a knife in one hand and the slice in the other to butter opened bread: +10% hunger, saturation and effect duration by default, one slice used.
secret: Butter is the only ingredient that lengthens effects, up to twice the longest.

use: Add a fermented spider eye to milk in a cauldron; after about 7.5 minutes harvest the cheese with an empty hand. It holds 16 slices and bounces like a bed.
secret: Be quick: cheese spoils 1.5 minutes after it is ripe and gives nothing.

lore: A slice with holes, and each hole a story.
use: Cut with a knife from a cheese block. Restores 2 hunger and 1.2 saturation, and is a sandwich ingredient.
secret: Slices only come off with a knife; breaking a cut block keeps its state in the item.

lore: A slice of celebration, small enough to carry.
use: A slice of cake. It counts as a sandwich ingredient.
secret: Yes, a cake sandwich is legal.

use: An empty cauldron filled with a milk bucket. After four stages it becomes butter; an empty bucket gets the milk back before that. With SimpleLib it is a reinforced milk cauldron.
secret: A fermented spider eye turns the milk to cheese instead.

lore: A book that tells how to stack a lunch properly.
use: The Simple Sandwiches Guide explains cutting boards, butter, cheese and sandwiches. Craft it shapeless from a book and a crafting table.
secret: Its chapters unlock as the matching recipes land in your recipe book. Nothing is consumed.

lore: {name}: a plank with a purpose, scored by every knife that came before.
use: Place it on a block, put bread on it and open the loaf with a knife; add toppings, then close it and collect the sandwich with an empty hand.
secret: A click on the board always acts on the board while you hold bread, food, butter or a knife. Sneak to eat instead.
